name: fokker_planck_ou_classical
divergence_log: Fokker-Planck operator acts on a real probability density p(x,t) on a commuting configuration space. It cannot represent interference between classically distinct paths, phase-space negativity, or the quantum Smoluchowski / quantum-Brownian-motion regime where position and momentum are non-commuting. The canonical nonclassical analog is a Caldeira-Leggett master equation on rho(x,x';t).
